evidence.original_label: Use of Proceeds (Bonds with Stock Acquisition Rights)
evidence.excerpt: (13) Use of Proceeds. The net proceeds from the issuance of the Bonds with Stock Acquisition Rights are estimated to amount to approximately 100 billion yen. The Company intends to allocate such net proceeds to the following growth investments: (i) Approximately ¥50 billion by March 2029 to enhance semiconductor tester supply capacity (for SoC Test Systems, the target capacity of 7,500 systems per year within a couple of years).

notes: Planned SoC Test System manufacturing capacity target, disclosed as part of the use-of-proceeds note for Bonds with Stock Acquisition Rights issued around the 84th-term filing date (June 2026). A PLAN, not current or attained capacity: the issuer's own timing language is 'within a couple of years' for the 7,500-systems/year target itself, bundled with a separate, more precise capex timeline ('Approximately Y50 billion by March 2029') for the broader tester-supply-capacity investment this target sits inside. Because 'within a couple of years' is not a datable target year, the period end is recorded as the filing's own as-of date (March 31, 2026, the fiscal year end this disclosure is appended to), NOT a fabricated 2027/2028 target date; the vague timing is preserved verbatim in this note rather than guessed at. Two companion investments in the same note (not registered as separate observations, since they are not production-capacity figures): approximately Y20 billion by March 2027 for inventory, and approximately Y30 billion by March 2028 to accelerate next-generation testing-solution development.
